books.title: Prealgebra
books.author: Richard Rusczyk, David Patrick, Ravi Boppana (Art of Problem Solving)
books.license: Copyright AoPS Inc. Paid textbook. Official free material: chapter 1 excerpt PDF (https://s3.amazonaws.com/aops-cdn.artofproblemsolving.com/products/prealgebra/exc1.pdf), TOC PDF (https://s3.amazonaws.com/aops-cdn.artofproblemsolving.com/products/prealgebra/toc.pdf), index PDF (.../prealgebra/index.pdf), online-book preview page (https://artofproblemsolving.com/ebooks/prealgebra-ebook/preview), and the free chapter-aligned video series (https://artofproblemsolving.com/videos/prealgebra).
books.note: Solutions are in a separate paid solutions manual (text 608 pp + solutions). Chapter list taken from the official TOC PDF. Alcumus (free) has a Prealgebra track aligned to this book.

books.title: Introduction to Algebra

books.license: Copyright AoPS Inc. Paid textbook. books.note: 656 pp text + 312 pp solutions manual (paid). Chapter list from official TOC PDF; the free video page lists the same 22 chapter titles.

books.title: Introduction to Counting & Probability

books.license: Copyright AoPS Inc. Paid textbook. books.title: Introduction to Geometry
books.author: Richard Rusczyk (Art of Problem Solving)
books.license: Copyright AoPS Inc. Paid textbook. books.title: Art of Problem Solving Volume 1: the Basics
books.author: Sandor Lehoczky, Richard Rusczyk
books.license: Copyright AoPS Inc. Paid textbook. Official free material: chapter 5 excerpt PDF (https://s3.amazonaws.com/aops-cdn.artofproblemsolving.com/products/aops-vol1/exc1.pdf), TOC PDF (https://s3.amazonaws.com/aops-cdn.artofproblemsolving.com/products/aops-vol1/toc.pdf), preview page (https://artofproblemsolving.com/ebooks/aops-vol1-ebook/preview).

chapters.title: Shifts, Turns, Flips, Stretches, and Squeezes

books.note: 7th edition, 288 pp text + 144 pp solutions (paid). Written specifically for MATHCOUNTS/AMC-level contest prep; 500+ problems culled from contests. The free chapter 5 excerpt covers divisibility, primes, bases, and the start of modular arithmetic.

books.title: Mastering AMC 10/12
books.author: Omega Learn (501(c)(3) nonprofit; Sohil Rathi et al.)
books.license: Free download from the author's site (https://www.omegalearn.org/books/Mastering_AMC_1012_Book.pdf, ~19 MB); no open license stated, all rights reserved by Omega Learn. Book is 'a work in progress'.

chapters.title: Area and Length of Complex Shapes

books.note: The single best free full text for this app: ~690 pages, every chapter has formulas, worked examples, practice problems (mostly past AMC 10/12 problems) and a linked video lecture plus video solutions (YouTube playlist 'Mastering AMC 10/12 Course'). Chapter list extracted from the PDF's table of contents. Companion 'Mastering AMC 8' and 'The Book of Mathematical Formulas & Strategies' are listed at https://www.omegalearn.org/books.

books.title: CEMC Open Courseware, Grades 9/10/11 Mathematics (7 courses)
books.author: Centre for Education in Mathematics and Computing, University of Waterloo
books.license: Free, no registration required (CEMC states courseware is free to use without registration; optional account only for progress tracking). Copyright University of Waterloo, all rights reserved; no open license.

chapters.title: Number Sense and Algebraic Expressions (units: classification/operations of numbers, exponents, manipulating algebraic expressions, radicals and rational functions, prime factorization)

Linear Relations, Analytic Geometry, Data Management, and Statistics (units: linear equations incl. rate/ratio/percent and inequalities, linear relations, slope, equations of lines, linear systems, line segments and analytic geometry, data and statistics)
Quadratic Relations (units: properties of quadratics, algebraic representations, algebraic skills/factoring, graphing, solving problems)
Introduction to Functions (function notation, domain and range, transformations, inverses)
Sequences, Series, and Financial Literacy (arithmetic and geometric sequences and series)

Measurement, Geometry, and Trigonometry (units: Pythagorean theorem / composite areas / pyramids, cones, spheres / optimization; geometric relationships; trigonometry; angles in standard position and identities)

books.note: Each course URL is https://courseware.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/<id>. Every unit ends with 'All Exercises, Answers, and Solutions' (full worked solutions) and an Enrichment set of harder problems. Curricular rather than contest-flavoured, so best used for tier-1 foundations and for alg-functions/geo-trig/geo-solid reading. A Grades 7/8 course (id 27) and 'Problem Solving and Mathematical Discovery' (id 40) also exist (not inspected).

books.title: CEMC Past Contests: Pascal (Gr 9), Cayley (Gr 10), Fermat (Gr 11) with full solutions
books.author: CEMC, University of Waterloo
books.license: Free download (last ~10 years posted on site: problems PDF + solutions PDF per contest). Copyright University of Waterloo; no open license stated.

chapters.title: 25-question multiple-choice contests, difficulty comparable to AMC 8 (Pascal) through AMC 10 (Cayley/Fermat)
Builds custom sets of past Gauss/Pascal/Cayley/Fermat problems filtered by topic (https://cemc.uwaterloo.ca/resources/problem-set-generator)
Weekly problems for grades 9/10 and 11/12 with solutions, filterable by theme (Algebra, Geometry & Measurement, Number Sense, Data Management) (https://cemc.uwaterloo.ca/resources/potw.php)

books.note: Best non-AMC source of AMC-10-style multiple-choice problems with official worked solutions. The Problem Set Generator's topic filter maps reasonably onto the skill ids above.

books.title: Prealgebra 2e
books.author: Lynn Marecek, MaryAnne Anthony-Smith, Andrea Honeycutt Mathis (OpenStax, Rice University)
books.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 per the OpenStax book page (the preface fetch reported CC BY-NC-SA; confirm on the page before redistributing excerpts). Free web view and PDF.
books.note: School-level, not contest-level. Answers to all 'Try It' and odd-numbered section exercises are free; full solutions only for instructors. Useful as remedial reading for alg-linear / alg-ratios.

books.title: Intermediate Algebra 2e
books.author: Lynn Marecek, Andrea Honeycutt Mathis (OpenStax, Rice University)
books.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 per the OpenStax book page (preface fetch reported CC BY-NC-SA; confirm before redistributing). Free web view and PDF.

chapters.title: Sequences, Series and the Binomial Theorem

books.note: Odd-numbered answers free. Standard-curriculum treatment; good for a student who has never seen logs, radicals or the quadratic formula before starting contest material.

books.title: Discrete Mathematics: An Open Introduction (3rd ed.), Chapter 1 'Counting'
books.author: Oscar Levin (University of Northern Colorado)
books.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (free to download, print, remix, even sell). Full book at https://discrete.openmathbooks.org/dmoi3.html
books.note: The only truly open-licensed text found that covers stars-and-bars and PIE at the right depth. 275 of 473 exercises have full solutions in the free online version, 109 more have hints. Written for undergrads but chapter 1 needs only algebra.

books.title: Number Theory (notes)
books.author: Naoki Sato (hosted by Art of Problem Solving)
books.license: Free PDF posted by AoPS (rights-holder hosting). No open license stated.
books.note: Written for IMO-level students; the theorems in sections 1-2 are the right reference for nt-divisibility / nt-modular but the problems are far above AMC 10. Use as a reference sheet, not a problem source.

books.title: Geometry Unbound
books.author: Kiran S. Kedlaya
books.license: GNU Free Documentation License (PDF: https://kskedlaya.org/geometryunbound/gu-060118.pdf, version of 18 Jan 2006; no figures).

chapters.title: Rudiments; Triangle centers, circles, power of a point
Transformations; tricks of the trade (trig, coordinates)

books.note: Olympiad-level (grew out of MOP notes). Include only as an 'advanced reference' link for geo-circles / geo-trig; no solutions and no figures in the free PDF.

books.title: Mathematical Circles Topics (handouts)
books.author: Tom Davis (Berkeley / San Jose / Palo Alto math circles)
books.license: Free PDFs posted by the author; no license stated (author copyright). Site is HTTP-only.

chapters.title: How to Count Things (+ solnscount.pdf, full solutions)
Practical Probability: Casino Odds and Sucker Bets
Practical Calculation of Areas of Polygons (shoelace formula)
Geometry of the Circle; Four Points on a Circle (cyclic quadrilaterals)

books.note: Handout PDFs live at http://www.geometer.org/mathcircles/<file>. Only 'How to Count Things' ships a separate solutions file; most others have worked examples inline but unsolved problem lists.

books.license: Free PDFs posted by the Circle; no license stated.

chapters.title: e.g. Classical Geometry I & II (Stankova), All About N-gons, Multiplicative Functions, Pell's Equation, Induction (https://mathcircle.berkeley.edu/circle-archives/handouts/2008-2009)

books.license: Free PDFs posted by the team; no license stated.

chapters.title: Power of a Point and Radical Axis (https://www.nycmathteam.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/NYC_Orange_RadicalAxis_Handout.pdf)

books.license: Free downloads from UKMT (paper PDF, solutions PDF, and 'Solutions and Investigations' extended solutions per year). UKMT copyright, no open license.

chapters.title: AMC 2019 Intermediate practice problems with solutions

videoSeries.title: Omega Learn: Mastering AMC 10/12 Course (chapter-by-chapter companion to the free book)
